description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer application. It contains the structure and styles for the user interface, along with embedded JavaScript code to fetch and display database and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better visibility.

search-terms: embedded JavaScript for fetching database info
